title: Bot Chat
outcome: Hey! Here's the short version of who I am: **I'm Qwen** — a large language model developed by Alibaba Group. I'm an AI assistant built to be helpful, direct, and genuinely useful rather than verbose. **What I can do:** - **Reason & write** — I handle long documents well; very long context (hundreds of pages or hours-long video transcripts) can be processed and recalled with high precision. - **Get things done** — I'm not just a chatbot. I have real tools: I can run shell commands, read/write/edit files, search the web, drive a browser, generate code and verify it actually works, and manage scheduled jobs.
